note: Fresh threads have no rollout file yet, so thread/resume fails cleanly with -32600 'no rollout found' (both ephemeral AND non-ephemeral pre-turn). thread/turns/list on ephemeral threads fails; thread/items/list is not supported yet (-32601). Resume-after-restart therefore requires a persisted (post-turn) rollout.

error.message: no rollout found for thread id THREAD-n
ephemeral threads do not support thread/turns/list
